newsitem.title: USA: Clinton says encouraged by Russia cabinet changes.
newsitem.headline: Clinton says encouraged by Russia cabinet changes.

text.p: President Bill Clinton said on Wednesday he was encouraged by Russian cabinet appointments announced by President Boris Yeltsin this week.
"I'm encouraged by the new economic team President Yeltsin announced this week. It underscores Russia's commitment to continued reform," Clinton told reporters at the White House.

Clinton, speaking before leaving for a summit with Yeltsin in Helsinki, also said he would seek to overcome Russian objections to NATO expansion and said he wanted a "robust partnership" between NATO and Russia.
"I believe NATO and Russia should consult regularly and should act jointly whenever possible," Clinton said.
